neighbours.label: A recurring weekly or monthly schedule: 'every' or the weekday in 'meets every Thursday', 'second and fourth Tuesday'
fire: The knitting circle gathers every Wednesday afternoon in the church hall.
Our hiking club walks on the first and third Sunday of each month.
Free yoga classes are held on Monday evenings at the community center.
The farmers' market opens every Saturday morning from April to October.
Choir practice takes place weekly on Tuesday nights at seven.
The support group meets on alternate Fridays in room 12.
Story time for toddlers runs every Thursday at 10 am.
The chess club plays on the second Monday of every month.
quiet: The knitting circle held a single fundraiser last spring in the church hall.
Our hiking club walked up the mountain once, in the summer of 2019.
The yoga teacher moved to the community center from another town.
The farmers' market was founded by six families in 1998.
The choir performed a concert at the cathedral last December.
The support group was started by a nurse after her illness.
The toddlers listened to a story about a lost bear.
The chess club won the regional tournament in 2015.

notes: Output suppresses weekday tokens (Wednesday, Saturdays, evenings). A bare weekday in a one-off frame read 0.28 in probing, so near misses avoid weekdays.
